M15: reconcile accepted host baseline and publish C3 verification

Preserve source ownership and queued draft custody through the accepted49 host layout changes. Add exact-head Windows, native, Edge and full-repository evidence jobs.

Retain historical failures and partial acceptance. Keep sourceWorkbenchV1 and reviewer approval disabled.

specs.title: saved rows replace the name/action bank and apply only on explicit activation
save asks for a name on demand, selects its exact ID, and reports current then modified
same-task repeated activation is locked, and an already current row does not apply twice
failed apply keeps the chooser, arrangement, current identity and conversation draft
row overflow updates, renames and confirms deletion without applying on focus
cancel and IME keys preserve the name draft and unwind one overlay at a time
empty, loading and failed lists stay distinct and offer retry
historical records are explicit recovery rows and never inferred as the current split
a stale metadata failure from the old workspace cannot replace the new workspace state
keyboard users can reach row overflow with Tab and Escape returns through both layers
externally changed saved metadata invalidates an observed current badge
reopening reveals and focuses the observed selected row
pending layout application cannot race a workspace preset change
short narrow dark chooser scrolls with row gaps, keyboard access and distinct states
